# Google Workspace OAuth2 library

Source: https://github.com/googleworkspace/apps-script-oauth2/blob/main/dist/OAuth2.gs
Downloaded 29 October 2026 from the official googleworkspace repository.
SHA-256 (raw distribution): 73e240cdf2ad217c97fbd864e150ffc380c2220b0f040fcaa6143a81ef58ad0d
License: Apache-2.0, retained in LICENSE-OAuth2 and the source header.

The build verifies this hash and includes the library unchanged. OrbitDesk wraps it with its own owner, pending-callback, capability, identity and public-response controls; upstream token exchange alone does not enforce those application rules.
